analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied head-side patch adds a 'Native Flint' section (head lines 1742-1868) describing model_type flint, FlintModel.cbv2Prefill, a strict loader, and native KV. The two supplied units are base_text slices (base lines 822-1621) with no changed lines. The patch excerpt is truncated at 'EngineV', so the remainder of the new section was not visible. No code, config, key handling, protocol or cache logic changes in the supplied evidence, so no threat-model control (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, T-041, A-001) is weakened by this documentation change. The visible text describes a strict loader that rejects missing, extra or duplicate tensors and conflicting aliases, and describes prefill skipping vocabulary projection for evaluation-only chunks. These are consistent with existing T-012/T-027 posture and add no new claim of secrecy or attestation. Open questions for integration: the rest of the Flint section was not visible, and the actual FlintModel implementation, its prefix-cache identity and SSD checkpoint binding (T-041), and whether Flint is admitted via EngineV2SupportedModels are not in scope. Any claims there about cache or attestation behavior need verification against the code, which was not supplied. I identified no concrete regression, but the incomplete patch excerpt limits confidence.
